Guidance & outlook: The major highlights of the FY2026 are as under: Total income stood at ₹ 1,626.80 lakhs in FY2026 as compared to ₹ 1535.90 lakhs in FY2025.
PAT stood at ₹179.37 lakhs in FY2026 as compared to ₹147.81 lakhs in FY2025, thereby registering a growth of 21.35% in PAT.
Indiaʼs near-term outlook In its latest World Economic Outlook report, the IMF said India's economy is now expected to grow by 7.3% in FY26, up 0.7 percentage points from its earlier estimate.
Growth & demand: Growth is projected to be higher in low-income countries, reaching an average of 5.6% over 2026-27, buoyed by firming domestic demand, recovering exports, and moderating inflation.
As India enters 2026, several themes will shape the next phase of growth and demand the same level of pragmatism.

Domestically, the three biggest risks that need to be monitored are: • Poor transmission of policy rate cuts to credit growth. • A resurgence of inflation as demand picks up fast (and core has been above 4%). • Possible implications of lower tax revenues for fiscal consolidation this year.
Margins & costs: MAINTENANCE OF COST RECORDS AND COST AUDIT The requirement of maintenance of cost records as specified by the Central Government under sub-section (1) of section 148 of the Companies Act, 2013, and audit of cost records were not applicable to the Company during the year under review.
Global inflation is projected to edge down to 2.6% in 2026, reflecting softer labor markets and lower energy prices.

Growth is expected to stand between 7.5% and 7.8% in fiscal 2025 to 2026, and then between 6.6% and 6.9% in fiscal 2026 to 2027, buoyed by the rollout of new goods and services tax (GST) rules and slowing inflation.
Capex & expansion: Debojyoti Banerjee during the year under review acquired: 12,000 (0.43%) equity shares of the Company from open market on 19-12-2025; 33,600 (1.19%) equity shares of the Company from open market on 31-03-2026.
In February 2025, Netflix disclosed plans for an impressive content expansion across India by 2025, surging its yearly budget to USD 18 billion.

Among traditional channels, out of home advertising is the only medium projected to grow, expanding at a CAGR of 3% through 2027 on the back of digital OOH expansion and enhanced urban infrastructure.
Balance sheet & cash: The Company has not paid any dividend in past, thus, details of the amount of dividend which remained unpaid/unclaimed for a period of 7 years and due for transfer to IEPF is not applicable to the Company.
DIVIDEND The management has decided to reinvest the money in working capital and overall growth of the company.
Dividend To strengthen the financial position of the Company and to augment working capital, your directors do not recommend any dividend for the FY 2026.
Risks & challenges: RISK MANAGEMENT POLICY Your Companyʼs Risk Management Framework is designed to enable risks to be identified, assessed and mitigated appropriately.
As India enters 2026, it will have to carefully manage both global and domestic risks.

Recent Developments in the Media and Entertainment Industry are: Indiaʼs advertising industry continued to demonstrate steady growth in 2025 at 8.3% to reach Rs 1,21,339 crore, macroeconomic uncertainty notwithstanding.
